           SUM(o.progcyclecount) AS tpc,

           AVG(o.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,

    FROM robot_details r
    JOIN operation o ON o.operbotdetref = r.botdetreg
    GROUP BY r.botdetreg, r.modelseriesval
), robot_program_stats AS (
    SELECT r.modelseriesval, r.botdetreg, o.currprogval,
           SUM(o.progcyclecount)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(o.cycletimesecval), 0) AS program_oce
    FROM robot_details r

WITH robot_stats AS (
    SELECT r.botdetreg, r.modelseriesval,
           SUM(o.progcyclecount) AS tpc,
           SUM(o.progcyclecount)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(o.cycletimesecval), 0) AS oce,
           AVG(o.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.currprogval) AS program_count
    FROM robot_details r
    JOIN operation o ON o.operbotdetref = r.botdetreg
    GROUP BY r.botdetreg, r.modelseriesval
), robot_program_stats AS (
    SELECT r.modelseriesval, r.botdetreg, o.currprogval,
           SUM(o.progcyclecount)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(o.cycletimesecval), 0) AS program_oce
    FROM robot_details r
    JOIN operation o ON o.operbotdetref = r.botdetreg
    GROUP BY r.modelseriesval, r.botdetreg, o.currprogval
), program_averages AS (
    SELECT modelseriesval, currprogval, AVG(program_oce) AS avg_program_oce
    FROM robot_program_stats
    GROUP BY modelseriesval, currprogval
), program_summary AS (
    SELECT modelseriesval,
           jsonb_build_object(
               'most_efficient_program', (array_agg(currprogval ORDER BY avg_program_oce DESC NULLS LAST, currprogval))[1],
               'avg_program_efficiency', AVG(avg_program_oce)
           ) AS efficiency_metrics
    FROM program_averages
    GROUP BY modelseriesval
), model_summary AS (
    SELECT modelseriesval, COUNT(*) AS robot_count,
           AVG(oce) AS avg_oce,
           AVG(tpc) AS avg_tpc,
           AVG(program_count) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oce < 100 AND tpc > 500000) AS low_efficiency_robots
    FROM robot_stats
    GROUP BY modelseriesval
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT m.modelseriesval, m.robot_count, m.avg_oce, m.avg_tpc,
       m.avg_programs_per_robot, p.efficiency_metrics, m.low_efficiency_robots
FROM model_summary m
JOIN program_summary p ON p.modelseriesval IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.modelseriesval
ORDER BY m.avg_oce DESC
LIMIT 50;
